CurrentIssues.ID: FunctionExpressionBody:LlmModelDownloadWorker.kt:LlmModelDownloadWorker${ return try { val definition = downloadDefinition(inputData.getString(KEY_MODEL_ID), aiSettingsStore.selectedModelDefinition()) .withPublishedFingerprint(publishedModels()) // Un solo modello installato alla volta (vedi LlmModelManager.selectAndDownload): // se un altro modello e' gia' su disco resta finche' questo non e' scaricato e verificato, poi si elimina. val currentlyInstalled = LlmModelCatalog.ALL.firstOrNull { it.id != definition.id && modelManager.isDownloaded(it) } // Solo quando cambia la percentuale: ogni setProgress e' una scrittura nel database di WorkManager. var lastPercent = -1L modelManager.selectAndDownload( newDefinition = definition, currentlyInstalled = currentlyInstalled, // Solo a modello installato e verificato il download diventa il modello in uso, prima che il vecchio sparisca. onInstalled = { if (definition.id != aiSettingsStore.selectedModelId()) aiSettingsStore.setSelectedModelId(definition.id) }, ) { downloaded, total -> val percent = if (total > 0) downloaded * PERCENT / total else PERCENT if (percent != lastPercent) { lastPercent = percent setProgress(workDataOf(KEY_BYTES_DOWNLOADED to downloaded, KEY_TOTAL_BYTES to total)) } } Result.success() } catch (error: CancellationException) { throw error } catch (_: ModelIntegrityException) { Result.failure(workDataOf(KEY_FAILURE_REASON to FAILURE_REASON_INTEGRITY)) } catch (_: ModelDownloadFailedException) { Result.failure() } catch (error: IOException) { when { error.isNoSpaceLeft() -> Result.failure(workDataOf(KEY_FAILURE_REASON to FAILURE_REASON_SPACE)) shouldRetryDownload(runAttemptCount) -> Result.retry() else -> Result.failure() } } catch (_: Exception) { Result.failure() } }

FunctionExpressionBody:LlmModelUpdateCheckWorker.kt:LlmModelUpdateCheckWorker${ return try { val definition = aiSettingsStore.selectedModelDefinition() if (modelManager.isDownloaded(definition)) { val remote = appStatusClient.fetchAppStatus().aiModels.firstOrNull { it.modelId == definition.id } // Lo sha del file su disco, non quello del catalogo dei modelli dell'APK: chi ha scaricato la versione // precedente con lo stesso id (cambia solo lo sha256) altrimenti non verrebbe mai avvisato. // Calcolato (una volta sola) solo se serve, cioe' se c'e' una entry remota da confrontare. val installedSha256 = remote?.let { modelManager.installedSha256(definition) } if (remote != null && installedSha256 != null && isAiModelUpdateAvailable(installedSha256, remote)) { notifier.notifyAiModelUpdateAvailable(remote) } } Result.success() } catch (error: CancellationException) { throw error } catch (_: IOException) { Result.retry() } catch (_: Exception) { Result.failure() } }
